Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added 72 lighthearted videogame-reference lines for Porter to share only while genuinely idle. Banter waits a random two to five hours by default, uses every line before reshuffling, stays silent around recognized winners and active trades, and includes configurable minimum and maximum intervals.
